setup: git clone https://github.com/receiptful/escpost build/external/escpost && git -C build/external/escpost checkout c4a7665
notes: Exercises ESC $, ESC \, GS L and GS W, the print positions and the print area. The case names the NT-5890K profile, whose printable_width_dots is 384. The stream is the hexadecimal file of the repository, not a run of the library. Reviewed against the expected PNG of the case: the same 120 dots and the same 96 ink rows, and the first three markers on the same dots. The last two differ: the calibrated NT-5890K of the case ignores an ESC $ after printable data and a negative ESC \, which its notes call a firmware quirk, so its markers form one block; this renderer follows the Epson baseline and draws them at x 40 and x 20.
